answer: Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a dawn index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Because the bridge index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the echo audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 60 aliases therefore needs 60 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
